text: Do you have a history of kidney stones, and are you experiencing any fever or chills? I'd also like to know if the pain radiates to your groin.

text: My main symptom is Hematuria and right flank pain. I also have History of recurrent urinary tract infections, No recent trauma. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Tuberculosis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the acid-fast bacilli culture is negative, renal tuberculosis is unlikely. I need to investigate other causes for your hematuria and flank pain, such as malignancy or stones. REQUEST TEST: CT_Urography

text: Since the CT urography is normal, we can rule out stones, tumors, and structural abnormalities, which makes renal tuberculosis even less likely.
